ProjectGu.Combat.GuAbilityDef.label: Black Boar cultivation
ProjectGu.Combat.GuAbilityDef.description: The Gu Master sits and lets the Black Boar Gu temper their body with the strength of a black boar. Each pulse spends primeval essence and permanently develops their Black Boar strength. Stopping keeps all development, and the session can be resumed without waiting.

effectNotes.li: Permanently develops Black Boar strength: up to +40% melee damage, +50% carrying capacity, +20% mining speed and +15% construction speed at full development.
The bonus grows with every successful pulse; full development takes about 15 days of regular sessions.
Development belongs to the body. Withdrawing, transferring or losing the Gu keeps it.

limitations.li: One Black Boar strength per body. Once fully developed, no Black Boar Gu can add more.
Each pulse needs primeval essence; with too little, the session pauses and can be resumed later.
Requires an undrafted, conscious Gu Master. Drafting, another order, incapacitation or withdrawing the Gu suspends the session.
